import asyncio
from vllm import AsyncLLMEngine, SamplingParams, AsyncEngineArgs

args = AsyncEngineArgs(model="{{model_id}}", gpu_memory_utilization={{gpu_mem_util}})
engine = AsyncLLMEngine.from_engine_args(args)
params = SamplingParams(temperature=0.7, max_tokens=256)

async def gen(prompt: str) -> str:
    out_text = ""
    async for out in engine.generate(prompt, params, request_id="r1"):
        out_text = out.outputs[0].text
    return out_text

print(asyncio.run(gen("hello")))
